New York State Teachers Retirement System Lowered Its Holding in Cigna (CI) as Stock Value Declined; Glaxosmithkline (GSK) Position Has Boosted by Kahn Brothers Group Inc
May 21, 2018 - By Michael Collier
New York State Teachers Retirement System decreased its stake in Cigna Corp (CI) by 1.46% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. New York State Teachers Retirement System sold 5,824 shares as the company’s stock declined 18.61% with the market. The institutional investor held 391,867 shares of the medical specialities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $79.58M, down from 397,691 at the end of the previous reported quarter. New York State Teachers Retirement System who had been investing in Cigna Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $43.43 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.27% or $0.48 $178.55. About 118,918 shares traded. Cigna Corporation (NYSE:CI) has risen 13.35% uptrending. It has outperformed by 1.80% the S&P500.
Irving Kahn increased its stake in Glaxosmithkline (GSK) by 11.56% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kahn Brothers Group Inc bought 118,028 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.28% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Irving Kahn held 1.14 million shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $40.41 billion, up from 1.02M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kahn Brothers Group Inc who had been investing in Glaxosmithkline for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $98.68 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.32% or $0.13 $40.16. About 334,863 shares traded. GlaxoSmithKline plc (NYSE:GSK) has declined 10.07% downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.62% the S&P500.
Kahn Brothers Group Inc, which manages about $636.58B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Sterling Bancorp (NYSE:STL) by 30,091 shares to 891,749 shares, valued at $21.94B in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Seaboard Corp (NYSEMKT:SEB) by 50 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 7,839 shares, and cut its stake in Nam Tai Ppty (NYSE:NTP).
Among 18 analysts covering GlaxoSmithKline ( NYSE:GSK ), 9 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 8 Hold. Therefore 50% are positive. GlaxoSmithKline had 29 analyst reports since September 8, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was upgraded by JP Morgan on Monday, October 12 to “Neutral”. The stock of GlaxoSmithKline plc (NYSE:GSK) has “Hold” rating given on Wednesday, February 14 by Cowen & Co. Argus Research maintained it with “Buy” rating and $48 target in Monday, December 7 report. The firm has “Buy” rating by Argus Research given on Friday, August 12. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Friday, February 26 by Cantor Fitzgerald. The company was upgraded on Wednesday, April 5 by BNP Paribas. As per Wednesday, September 14, the company rating was downgraded by BNP Paribas. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Tuesday, October 20 by Credit Suisse. On Friday, May 26 the stock rating was upgraded by Berenberg to “Buy”. The firm has “Neutral” rating by JP Morgan given on Wednesday, April 26.

After $4.11 actual EPS reported by Cigna Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -13.38% negative EPS growth.
